headlines.summary: 近日，2025年度金融科技发展奖评审领导小组会议在京召开。中国人民银行副行长邹澜、中国证监会副主席刘浩凌出席会议并讲话。会议强调，金融业要深入贯彻落实党的二十大和二十届历次全会精神，聚焦做好金融“五篇大文章”，稳步加大金融科技投入与创新探索，积极推动自主可控技术向着“全面好用”“更稳更优”目标迈进，不断提升行业数智化水平，积极探索人工智能在金融管理和服务领域的应用，防范模型应用伴生风险，守牢安全发展底线，促进金融服务提质增效。要持续发挥金融科技发展奖示范引领作用，把握前沿技术发展机遇，夯实数据底座，强化科技治理，更好支撑防风险、强监管、促高质量发展各项工

headlines.title_en: Meeting of the Leading Group for Review of Fintech Development Awards held
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the 2025 Fintech Development Award Review Leading Group meeting was held in Beijing. PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan and CSRC Vice Chairman Liu Haoling attended and delivered speeches. The meeting emphasized that the financial sector must thoroughly implement the spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress and all plenary sessions of the 20th Central Committee, focus on the "five major articles" of finance, steadily increase fintech investment and innovation exploration, actively push independent and controllable technologies toward the goals of "fully usable" and "more stable and better," continuously raise the industry's digital and intelligent level, actively explore AI applications in financial management and services, guard against risks accompanying model applications, hold the bottom line of safe development, and promote higher quality and efficiency in financial services. It is necessary to continue giving play to the demonstrative and leading role of the Fintech Development Award, seize opportunities in frontier technology development, consolidate the data foundation, strengthen tech governance, and better support the work of preventing risks, strengthening regulation, and promoting high-quality development.

headlines.title: 平安证券互换便利业务落地并开启首批投资 支持资本市场健康稳定发展
headlines.summary: 【平安证券互换便利业务落地并开启首批投资 支持资本市场健康稳定发展】为支持资本市场健康稳定发展，中国人民银行于11月3日启动第三批证券、基金、保险公司互换便利（SFISF）操作。本次操作金额1000亿元，采用费率招标方式，31家证券、基金公司参与投标，中标费率为10bp（基点）。截至11月11日，平安证券互换便利业务已顺利落地，完成首笔回购融资交易及第一批买入操作。

headlines.title_en: Ping An Securities' swap facility business launched and first batch of investments initiated to support healthy and stable development of capital market
headlines.summary_en: [Ping An Securities' SFISF business implemented and first batch of investments launched to support the healthy and stable development of the capital market] To support the healthy and stable development of the capital market, the People's Bank of China launched the third batch of Securities, Funds, and Insurance Companies Swap Facility (SFISF) operations on November 3. This operation amounted to 100 billion yuan and adopted a rate bidding method; 31 securities and fund companies participated in bidding, and the winning rate was 10bp (basis points). As of November 11, Ping An Securities' SFISF business had been smoothly implemented, completing its first repo financing transaction and the first batch of purchase operations.

headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth continued to accelerate last month amid the ongoing US-Iran conflict that is fuelling uncertainties in the global energy market, while consumer inflation remained subdued.
The producer price index (PPI) rose 5.7 per cent year on year in October, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Monday. It marked another record high since mid-2022, following a 5 per cent rise in September.

headlines.title_en: Research highlights | Changjiang Securities: China State Construction's dividend policy is stable, with sufficient margin of safety under high dividend yield
headlines.summary_en: A Changjiang Securities research report pointed out that China State Construction Engineering's revenue contraction dragged down profit, while stable per-share dividends provide a margin of safety. The company's net profit attributable to shareholders for Q1-Q3 2026 was 28.714 billion yuan, down 24.81% year on year; third-quarter revenue alone was 359.874 billion yuan, down 20.02% year on year. The gross margin rebounded year on year, but revenue contraction and higher expense ratios and income tax burden weighed on profit. Operating cash flow improved year on year in the first three quarters, while net outflow expanded in the third quarter alone. Industrial plants and data centers became growth highlights in housing construction, and overseas orders and revenue continued to grow. The company's newly signed overseas contracts amounted to 281.1 billion yuan, up 66.9% year on year. headlines.title: 商务部：中欧医疗器械专场贸易对接会达成100余项合作意向
headlines.summary: 11月12日，商务部新闻发言人何亚东在例行新闻发布会上表示，日前举办的中欧医疗器械专场贸易对接会是中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会一项重要的成果共识。商务部会同财政部、国家卫健委等部门组织160多家国内医疗机构和企业参与市场化采购，欧方组织40多家医疗器械企业参会，双方达成合作意向超过100项。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM: China-EU medical device special trade matchmaking meeting reaches more than 100 cooperation intentions
headlines.summary_en: On November 12, Ministry of Commerce spokesperson He Yadong said at a regular press conference that the recently held China-EU medical devices special trade matchmaking meeting was an important outcome and consensus of the second regular meeting of the China-EU trade and investment consultation mechanism. The Ministry of Commerce, together with the Ministry of Finance, the National Health Commission, and other departments, organized more than 160 domestic medical institutions and enterprises to participate in market-based procurement, while the European side organized more than 40 medical device enterprises to attend. The two sides reached more than 100 cooperation intentions. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 科博达：董事长提议回购公司股份，回购资金总额不低于1.5亿元且不超过2.5亿元
headlines.summary: 科博达公告，公司董事会于2026年11月12日收到董事长柯桂华先生《关于提议回购公司股份的函》。柯桂华基于对公司未来发展的信心和对公司价值的认可，提议公司使用自有或自筹资金通过上海证券交易所交易系统以集中竞价交易方式回购公司已发行的部分人民币普通股（A股）股票，回购股份拟用于员工股权激励/员工持股计划。回购资金总额不低于人民币1.5亿元（含），不超过人民币2.5亿元（含），回购价格不超过董事会通过回购股份决议前30个交易日公司股票交易均价的150%，具体以董事会审议通过的回购股份方案为准，回购期限为自公司董事会审议通过本次回购股份方案之日起6个月内。

headlines.title_en: Keboda: Chairman proposes share buyback, with total repurchase funds of no less than 150 million yuan and no more than 250 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Keboda announced that the company's board of directors received a letter from Chairman Ke Guihua on November 12, 2026, proposing a share repurchase. Based on confidence in the company's future development and recognition of the company's value, Ke Guihua proposed that the company use its own funds or self-raised funds to repurchase part of its issued RMB ordinary shares (A-shares) through the Shanghai Stock Exchange trading system by way of centralized bidding, with the repurchased shares intended for employee equity incentives/employee stock ownership plans. The total repurchase amount shall be no less than 150 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 250 million yuan (inclusive), and the repurchase price shall not exceed 150% of the average trading price of the company's shares over the 30 trading days before the board resolution approving the repurchase. The specifics shall be subject to the repurchase plan approved by the board of directors, and the repurchase period shall be within 6 months from the date the board of directors approves the repurchase plan.

headlines.title_en: UK economy posts fastest growth in two and a half years in Q3; investors bet on December rate hike
headlines.summary_en: The UK economy posted its fastest growth in two and a half years, with businesses and consumers showing resilience amid the energy shock triggered by the Iran war. Data released by the UK Office for National Statistics on Thursday showed that third-quarter GDP grew 0.7%, accelerating from 0.5% in the second quarter. The figure was in line with the median forecast of institutions. In September alone, GDP grew 0.2%, better than the previously expected zero growth. Since the outbreak of the Iran war, the UK economy has outperformed previous forecasts of a slowdown, partly thanks to spending related to AI applications. headlines.title: 日本央行审议委员浅田统一郎：日本央行不直接管理汇率，因此无法就美元兑日元处于何种水平较为合适置评
headlines.summary: 日本央行审议委员浅田统一郎：日本央行不直接管理汇率，因此无法就美元兑日元处于何种水平较为合适置评。 即使日本央行政策利率达到符合其政策目标的水平，央行仍可能在此基础上进一步加息或降息。 希望在每次政策会议上综合评估上行和下行风险以及金融条件，再作出政策决定。 目前无意提议降息。 中性利率有可能略高于日本央行目前的政策利率水平。 我并不反对加息。 未来某个时候，我们可能需要缓步上调利率。 我们若要加息，必须谨慎把握加息步伐。

headlines.title_en: BOJ Policy Board member Toichiro Asada: The BOJ does not directly manage exchange rates, so it cannot comment on what level is appropriate for the USD/JPY
headlines.summary_en: Bank of Japan Policy Board member Asada Toshiro: The Bank of Japan does not directly manage exchange rates, so it cannot comment on what level of the dollar-yen exchange rate is appropriate. Even if the Bank of Japan's policy rate reaches a level consistent with its policy target, the central bank may still raise or cut rates further on that basis. He hopes to comprehensively assess upside and downside risks and financial conditions at each policy meeting before making policy decisions. At present, he has no intention of proposing a rate cut. The neutral rate may be slightly higher than the Bank of Japan's current policy rate level. He is not opposed to raising rates. At some point in the future, we may need to raise interest rates gradually. If we are to raise rates, we must carefully grasp the pace of increases.

headlines.summary: 欧派家居公告，公司此前审议通过回购股份预案，拟使用不低于人民币1亿元（含）且不超过人民币2亿元（含）的自有资金或自筹资金，以不超过人民币46.25元/股（含）的价格回购公司股份，回购股份将全部予以注销并减少注册资本。2026年11月12日，公司以集中竞价交易方式首次回购公司股份34.18万股，占公司总股本的比例为0.056%，回购最高成交价格29.65元/股，最低成交价格28.95元/股，已支付总金额999.8万元（不含交易费用）。

headlines.title_en: Oppein Home: First share buyback of 341,800 shares, paying 9.998 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Oppein Home announced that the company previously approved a share repurchase plan, intending to use no less than 100 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 200 million yuan (inclusive) of its own funds or self-raised funds to repurchase company shares at a price of no more than 46.25 yuan per share (inclusive), and all repurchased shares will be canceled and registered capital reduced. On November 12, 2026, the company repurchased 341,800 shares for the first time through centralized bidding, accounting for 0.056% of the company's total share capital. The highest repurchase price was 29.65 yuan per share, and the lowest was 28.95 yuan per share, with a total amount paid of 9.998 million yuan (excluding transaction fees).

headlines.title_en: Aitek: Plans to repurchase shares for 30 million yuan to 50 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: ETEC announced that it plans to repurchase company shares for no less than 30 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 50 million yuan (inclusive), at a repurchase price of no more than 48.57 yuan per share (inclusive), with the repurchased shares intended for equity incentives or employee stock ownership plans. Based on the upper limit of the repurchase price, the expected number of shares to be repurchased is 617,700 to 1,029,400 shares, accounting for 0.34% to 0.57% of total share capital. The repurchase period is within 12 months from the date the board of directors approves the repurchase plan, and the source of funds is the company's own funds or self-raised funds.
